definition: stud = visible outward stud cap centre, including partial diagram occlusion; arrow_tip = geometric point of the drawn arrowhead
limitations: Expanded real direction training uses Superman, Batman and Aquaman (39 arrows). Former Batman/Aquaman tests are now training diagnostics, not held-out accuracy. Doctor Doom (8 arrows on one page) remains excluded from training but is a development check after previous failures informed the work. Coding-agent-reviewed labels, not independent human ground truth. Head-base lengths approximate; null shaft paths unannotated.

annotationCorrection: Aquaman coarse-grid labels refined against magnified source images after discovering several points on receiving studs or white outlines instead of arrowhead tips. Both models re-evaluated with the same corrected labels, without retraining or threshold selection. Original labels archived in arrow-comparison/superseded-grid-labels.json.
directionConvention: unit vector from head_base to tip; image x right, y down. Final local arrowhead direction, not tail-to-tip displacement.
